name: Kyubi
description: (Tag:illusion+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:nature)(Tag:nature+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:spirit)Race Change - You are a Kyubi, a nine-tailed Kitsune, a powerful fox yokai semi-spiritual being incredibly attuned to nature and illusions. You possess superhuman physical ability and greatly increased energy reserves. You swap between your nine-tailed form and a supernaturally good-looking human form at will. You naturally use [Nine-Tailed Foxfire] and possess great affinity for Stranger and Nature-based abilities and spells, making them more efficient to use and maintain.
